rebuttal_or_critique: I acknowledge the concerns of Deputy Governor Patra regarding the headline inflation print of 7.44%; however, I caution against a knee-jerk reaction to supply-side food price volatility. The core inflation at 4.90% indicates that the underlying demand pressures remain contained. Raising rates further, as suggested by Dr. Patra, would impose an unnecessary burden on the real economy when growth is at 7.80% but still in a fragile recovery phase. I agree with the Governor and Dr. Bhide that maintaining the status quo is prudent, as the current repo rate of 6.50% already provides a positive real rate. We must avoid over-tightening in response to transitory shocks that monetary policy is poorly equipped to address.
